_note: Children (note 12 slice 5, #938). Every number, name and line is a placeholder (note 07; child sprites and writing are M3d). Times are H:MM on the 6:00 to 26:00 day. {n} is the child's slot, 1 or 2, which picks the bed and the play spot.

ask._note: The spouse asks after the player goes to bed, once the nursery exists. 'Not now' is never a no: it only waits. All in days.
ask.text: PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} sits on the edge of the bed. Would you like to start a family? There is no hurry.
ask.yes: PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} smiles. A child will join you in a few days.
ask.notNow: PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} nods. We can ask again another time.

arrival: PLACEHOLDER TEXT: A child, {child}, has come to the nursery.

baby: PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} gurgles and reaches for your finger.
PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} blinks up at you, calm and round-eyed.
toddler: PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} holds up a wooden spoon. A gift!
PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} giggles and hides behind the crib.
PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} says a word that might be your name.
child: PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} asks how the crops are doing.
PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} shows you a drawing of the farm.
PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} wants to know what is in the village today.

already: PLACEHOLDER TEXT: {name} is busy playing and has nothing new to say today.
divorce: PLACEHOLDER TEXT: Your children stay with you on the farm. {name} remains a friend.
